Telangana BJP Leader Held for Assaulting Principal Over Urdu Classes

A local BJP leader in Telangana has been arrested following an alleged assault on a school principal. The incident occurred after parents reportedly complained that a Hindi teacher was teaching Urdu without permission. Police have filed two FIRs in connection with the case, and have also requested the removal of a video of the incident from social media.
